newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best puts Colonial Penn under review.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best puts Colonial Penn under review.

text.p: A.B. Best said Tuesday it placed the "A-" or excellent ratings of Colonial Penn Insurance Group under review effective immediately, with "positive" implications.
It said it took the step following announcement that GE Capital Services, a unit of General Electric Co, will acquire Colonial Penn for $950 million.
The deal was announced by Leucadia National Corp Colonial Penn's parent, on Monday. The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1997.

A.M. Best said the positive implications reflect benefits to the Colonial Penn group being owned by a financially stronger parent and potential benefits to Colonial Penn's direct-marketing efforts, it said.

The insurance rating and information services company said its action applies to Colonial Penn Insurance Co and its four insurance subsidiaries -- Colonial Penn Insurance Co, Colonial Penn Madison Insurance Co, Bay Colony Insurance Co and Bayside Casualty Insurance Co.

A.M. Best said the rating will remain under review pending the close of the transaction, review of the new Colonial Penn structure and discussions with management regarding operating plans and integration strategy.
